_about: lanePERFAB v102. Read by Scripts/PerfAb.cs (-perfab) and by perfab_report.py. Every number of the A/B run lives here. Arms are built from perf5_switches.json (switchesFile): 'each':'singles' = one arm per switch, 'bundle' = a bundle id, 'switches' = explicit ids. needsBuild switches (occlusion, sun cache asset) cannot toggle in a running player: skipped rows. Poses: the fighters are placed at anchor / axis / sepM (v66 wide pose = shadow_fixes.json diag) in front of the real lock cam; set enabled:true on 'mid' to measure a second pose (+1 pass). The last arm repeats the baseline: the gap between baseline and baseline_end is the drift / noise floor the report subtracts from every gain.

arms.note: noise floor: same as baseline, measured last
